model_annotations.English: The plot titled “GPT2-XL” illustrates two metrics, Efficacy\_top and noise\_E, for AlphaEdit and DeltaEdit across increasing x-axis values, with Efficacy\_top shown against the left y-axis and noise\_E shown against the right y-axis. The x-axis has no explicit label, uses a linear scale, and spans from approximately 250 to 3000, with labeled ticks at 500-unit intervals from 500 through 3000. The left y-axis is labeled “Efficacy\_top,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 85 to 100 with ticks every 2 units. The right y-axis is labeled “noise\_E,” uses a linear scale, and ranges from 2 to 12 with ticks every 2 units. For Efficacy\_top, AlphaEdit is drawn as a red dashed line with square markers and decreases across x, starting near 99.5 at the leftmost point (~250) and ending near 86.0 at 3000, with intermediate points around 99.0 (500), 98.8 (1000), 97.4 (1500), 95.8 (2000), and 92.2 (2500). DeltaEdit Efficacy\_top is shown as a purple dashed line with square markers and also declines, starting near 99.5 at ~250 and ending near 93.8 at 3000, with intermediate values around 99.2 (500), 99.0 (1000), 98.0 (1500), 97.0 (2000), and 95.8 (2500). For noise\_E, AlphaEdit is a solid red line with circular markers that increases from roughly 2.7 at ~250 to about 12.0 at 3000, passing through approximately 4.4 (500), 6.3 (1000), 7.7 (1500), 9.0 (2000), and 10.4 (2500). DeltaEdit noise\_E is a solid purple line with circular markers that similarly increases from about 2.2 at ~250 to about 11.2 at 3000, with intermediate values around 4.4 (500), 6.3 (1000), 7.7 (1500), 9.0 (2000), and 10.1 (2500).
model_annotations.German: The figure titled “GPT2-XL” illustrates how two metrics, **Efficacy\_top** and **noise\_E**, vary across the same sequence of x-values for two methods (AlphaEdit and DeltaEdit), with efficacy shown on the left y-axis and noise on the right y-axis. The x-axis has no visible label and uses a linear scale; plotted points occur at approximately 250, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, and 3000, with numeric tick labels shown at 500-unit intervals from 500 to 3000. The left y-axis is labeled **Efficacy\_top**, spans roughly 86 to 100 on a linear scale, and shows evenly spaced tick labels every 2 units (86, 88, …, 100). The right y-axis is labeled **noise\_E**, spans roughly 2 to 12 on a linear scale, and shows tick labels every 2 units (2, 4, …, 12). Four lines are plotted: **AlphaEdit Efficacy\_top** is a red dashed line with square markers that starts near ~99.4 at x≈250, stays near ~99 through x≈1000, then declines to ~97.4 at x≈1500, ~95.8 at x≈2000, ~92.1 at x≈2500, and ends near ~85.9 at x≈3000; **DeltaEdit Efficacy\_top** is a purple dashed line with square markers that starts near ~99.5 at x≈250, decreases gradually to ~99.2 (x≈500) and ~99.0 (x≈1000), then to ~98.0 (x≈1500), ~97.0 (x≈2000), ~95.8 (x≈2500), and ends near ~93.8 at x≈3000. **AlphaEdit noise\_E** is a red solid line with circular markers that increases from about ~2.7 at x≈250 to ~4.3 (x≈500), ~6.5 (x≈1000), ~7.8 (x≈1500), ~9.2 (x≈2000), ~10.4 (x≈2500), and ~11.8 at x≈3000. **DeltaEdit noise\_E** is a purple solid line with circular markers that also rises, from about ~2.4 at x≈250 to ~4.3 (x≈500), ~6.5 (x≈1000), ~7.8 (x≈1500), ~9.1 (x≈2000), ~10.2 (x≈2500), and ~11.2 at x≈3000.
